# What this brief decided for you

Shown to the salon owner at the top of every weekly brief, above the profit number.

## The week runs Monday to Sunday

We treated the week as Monday 00:00 through Sunday 23:59 in your salon's local time. Square
payouts that settle on a Monday for the prior Sunday are counted in the week they were earned,
not the week they landed. If your bank statement disagrees by a day, this is why.

## Receipts below 0.82 confidence were not matched

A photographed receipt is matched to a bank row only when our read of it scores 0.82 or higher.
Below that we leave the row in the verification queue rather than guessing. Two receipts fell
below the line this week.

## Nothing was categorized on your behalf

Uncategorized bank rows are shown as proposals with a suggested category. Nothing is committed
until you confirm it. Your contract prohibits categorizing spending without your confirmation and
we have not done so.

## The verification queue lists, it does not resolve

Your brief lists every item blocking verification and links to its source row. It does not yet
let you resolve an item from inside the brief — you resolve it in your own records and re-upload.
We shipped the listing first because the estimate is unusable without knowing what is missing,
and resolution actions need a write path we deliberately do not have.

## Parsed weekly totals are kept for 90 days

To show a week-over-week line we keep the parsed totals — not your uploaded files — in local
storage for 90 days. Your contract did not say whether we may retain anything. Clearing the
browser's site data deletes them immediately.
